Direction.description_en: The direction of the recovery plan. Only forward is supported

Name.description_en: The name of the recovery plan

RecoveryPlanId.description_en: The ID of the recovery plan

Status.description_en:
The status of the recovery plan. Valid values:

creating: The plan is being created.

updating: The plan is being updated.

deleting: The plan is being deleted.

failed: The plan failed.

init: The plan is initialized.

running: The plan is running
